name: Aster Worker Code Benchmark v1
purpose: Evaluate whether bounded Worker investigation improves repository issue repair on real coding tasks.

model_gets: decomposition goals only when explicitly assigned by runner
runtime_contract.success: hidden FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS checks pass in an isolated grading workspace.

difficulty_policy.hard: three or more coupled units, algorithmic/schema/grammar boundary, or source difficulty >4 hours; coordination is expected to require parent integration.
difficulty_policy.medium: two or more inspectable module/API units and an integration boundary; source difficulty generally 15 min–1 hour or 1–4 hours.
difficulty_policy.simple: localized issue with one implementation component; delegation is a negative control.

principles: Keep simple controls so automatic delegation overhead is measurable.
Do not classify by patch size alone.
Decomposition is runner metadata and is never appended to the model prompt.
Do not report this subset as an official SWE-bench score.

source.upstream_code_license: per repository; see each instance license fields
